operator_commissioning.selected_service_window_assumption: 07:00-19:00 participant working assumption, not an operator commitment
operator_commissioning.selection_basis: ROSTER-12H is the middle working case: it covers assumed morning-to-evening civic use more fully than the 8-hour fallback without treating the 18-hour stress case as an authorized commitment. A named operator and paid co-design process must confirm or replace the window.
operator_commissioning.service_rule: AI service availability must never exceed funded human-equivalent coverage; if the staffed desk and hot backup are both unavailable, the AI service closes and records HOLD.

hot_backup.secondary: funded on-call human phone/text relay during the same published service window
hot_backup.outage_rule: close the AI channel and issue an audited HOLD if neither human route is available

working_cost_sensitivity.derivation_note_zh: 区间只用于比较 16 行概念 BOQ、8 类成本和 8/12/18 小时排班情景；没有市场单价、供应商报价、税费确认、资金责任或采购授权。
working_cost_sensitivity.derivation_note_en: The bands compare the 16-line concept BOQ, eight cost components, and 8/12/18-hour roster scenarios only. No market rate, vendor quote, tax confirmation, funding responsibility, or procurement authority is claimed.
